summary: MoE layers without stored activation scales no longer enable the NVFP4-activation prefill from uninitialized memory
details: GLM-5.3-Flash checkpoints keep the MTP layer's routed experts weight-only (W4A16_NVFP4) without input scales. Their scale parameters were uninitialized, so with B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL_MIN_TOKENS set the draft layer could prefill with NVFP4 activations under a garbage global scale. They now start at zero, which the A4 prefill treats as absent: the draft layer stays W4A16.
MTP acceptance after a 13.4K-token prompt was unchanged in the measured case; the fix removes the dependence on uninitialized memory.
